analysis.summary: The PR introduces critical logic errors in subscription status styling and payment refund visibility, leading to incorrect UI feedback and hidden transaction data.

bugs.title: Incorrect Expiry Styling Logic
bugs.description: The logic for 'isAboutToExpire' was modified to flag all 'ACTIVE' subscriptions as errors, while simultaneously removing error styling for 'INACTIVE' (expired) subscriptions.
bugs.risk: This results in a significant UI regression where every active subscription will display its expiry date in red/error styling, while genuinely expired services will appear with neutral styling, causing user confusion regarding their service status.

bugs.title: Refund Information Suppressed for Card Payments
bugs.description: The 'showPaymentRefund' flag now explicitly excludes any order that contains credit card information ('lastFourDigits').
bugs.risk: This is a functional regression; users who paid via credit card will be unable to see the refund overview section in the UI, even if a refund has been successfully processed and the totalRefundPriceWithTax field is populated.

notBugs.reason: Although 'productType' is used in logic but not visible in the provided BFF interface diffs, it is likely an existing property in the truncated parts of the files; reporting it as missing would be speculative.
The movement of 'Status' information and the reordering of payment/price sections in PaymentOverview appear to be intentional layout adjustments for the business requirements of IBR-3121.
